Civil-society groups feared the revision could reduce official figures; the replacement appointment drew concerns about consultation, participation, transparency, control, and experience, and the revised total was lower.","notes":["The excerpt supports an announced recount, not an explicit presidential order."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E010","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The government continued promoting fossil-fuel production and use; the Dos Bocas refinery, opened by authorities in 2022, began operating in 2023. it only contains unrelated environmental, LGBTI+, and publication material."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E015","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The report records generally free and fair recent elections, generally effective enforcement of corruption penalties despite numerous corruption reports, cooperation by officials with human-rights groups, and investigations or resolutions in some corruption-related matters, alongside continuing corruption and weak enforcement of gender-violence laws.","notes":["The excerpt does not support labor-reform implementation across all 32 states or investigations/sanctions in abuse cases generally."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E016","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E017","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Mexico preserved preferential access to the U.S. market through the NAFTA renegotiation, renewed its commitment to open markets and global and regional supply chains, and the report identified weak contract enforcement, insecurity, underused human capital, and slow growth as continuing structural problems.","notes":["The excerpt does not support the broader claims about persistent poverty, infrastructure deficits, or unequal distribution of gains."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E018","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E019","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0004-E020","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
